title: 第 9 章 你给我站住第 10 章 陆云竟然败了
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 林凤瑶回到了自己的住处以后便关上门一个人坐在床上，能感受着体内的变化修为确实提升了一些。
虽然不多但已经很满意了。
因此她在心里盘算着，看来陈默体内的真元比她想象的要充沛得多。
如果能把他的真元全部榨干，那自己的修为说不定能直接突破到金丹大圆满。
想到这里以后她的嘴角微微上扬，看来得找个机会再把他弄晕狠狠的榨干一番。
不过不能太频繁得隔几天一次要不然他会起疑心。
这会儿她在心里做好了决定然后躺下来闭上眼睛休息。
第二天一早她从房间出来准备去修炼，可是就在走到半路上的时候却看到几个师妹正聚在一起小声议论着什么。
“你们听说了吗陆瑶师姐被陈默打了。”
“听说了而且听说被打得不轻脸上都肿了，不过我记得他以前不是练气期的废物吗什么时候变得这么厉害了？”
“谁知道呢说不定是一直在隐藏实力。”
“可是再厉害有什么用他打了陆瑶师姐，你们觉得陆云师兄能放过他？人家陆云师兄可是金丹大圆满的实力，在整个外门可没几个人是他对手。”
“那个陈默这次怕是要倒大霉了。”
“岂止是倒大霉，我觉得他这条命能不能保住都是问题。”
几个师妹都在八卦的说着，而且脸上都带着幸灾乐祸的表情。
“我还听说陆瑶师姐已经去找她哥陆云师兄了，我猜想陆师兄肯定会替她出这口气。”
“那陈默岂不是死定了？不过想来也是毕竟得罪陆云师兄的人还没有谁有好下场的。”
当林凤瑶听到这些话眉头微微皱了一下，于是走过去看着那几个师妹。
“都闲得没事干了？”
那几个师妹看到她立刻闭上了嘴一个个低下了头。
“还不去修炼一个个在这里嚼什么舌根？”
“是凤瑶师姐。”
几个师妹应了一声连忙散了各自朝修炼的地方走去，然而此刻的林凤瑶却站在原地没有动。
难道陆云要对付陈默？
这倒是个麻烦。
倒不是因为她心疼陈默，而是因为他现在是自己的炉鼎。
要是被陆云打死了她上哪去找这么好的炉鼎？因此摇了摇头还是决定先看看情况再说。
如果陆云真的要对陈默下手到时候她再出面也不迟。
同一时间的陈默也是刚刚从屋里走出来，昨天晚上他睡得不错体内的真元也很稳定。
经过一晚上的调息他感觉自己的状态比昨天又好了不少，虽说被那个女人占了便宜。
这会儿他站在院子里伸了个懒腰，站了一会儿决定去藏经阁看看。
说起藏经阁，不光是青云宗存放功法和法术的地方而且内外门弟子都可以去。
外门弟子只能进第一层观看下品和中品的法术，不过内门弟子是能进第二层观看上品法术的。
content_en:
After Lin Fengyao returned to her residence, she closed the door and sat on the bed alone. She could feel the changes in her body and her cultivation had indeed improved.
It's not much but I'm very satisfied.
Therefore, she was thinking in her mind. It seemed that the true energy in Chen Mo's body was much more abundant than she thought.
If he could drain all his true energy, then his cultivation might be able to directly break through to the Golden Elixir Great Perfection.
After thinking of this, the corners of her mouth rose slightly. It seemed that she had to find an opportunity to knock him out again and squeeze him dry.
But it can't be too frequent, every few days, or he will become suspicious.
She made her decision in her mind now and lay down, closing her eyes to rest.
The next morning she came out of her room to practice, but when she was halfway there, she saw several junior sisters gathering together and whispering about something.
"Have you heard that Senior Sister Lu Yao was beaten by Chen Mo?"
"I heard about it, and I heard that he was beaten so hard that his face was swollen, but I remember that he was not a waste in the Qi training period before. When did he become so powerful?"
"Who knows, maybe he has been hiding his strength."
"But no matter how powerful he is, what's the point of beating Senior Sister Lu Yao? Do you think Senior Brother Lu Yun can let him go? Senior Brother Lu Yun has the perfect strength of the Golden Core. There are few people in the entire outer sect who can match him."
"That Chen Mo is probably going to be in bad luck this time."
"Not only is it bad luck, I think it's a question of whether he can save his life."
Several junior sisters were gossiping, with expressions of gloating on their faces.
"I also heard that Senior Sister Lu Yao has gone to find her brother, Senior Brother Lu Yun. I guess Senior Brother Lu will definitely say this for her."
"Then isn't Chen Mo doomed? But after all, no one who offended Senior Brother Lu Yun has had a good ending."
When Lin Fengyao heard these words, she frowned slightly, then walked over and looked at the junior sisters.
"You've got nothing to do?"
The junior sisters immediately closed their mouths and lowered their heads when they saw her.
"If you don't go to practice, what are you talking about here?"
"It's Senior Sister Fengyao."
Several junior sisters responded and quickly dispersed and walked towards the place where they were practicing. However, at this moment, Lin Fengyao stood still and did not move.
Is Lu Yun going to deal with Chen Mo?
This is a problem.
It's not because she feels sorry for Chen Mo, but because he is her furnace now.
If Lu Yun beat her to death, where would she go to find such a good furnace? So I shook my head and decided to take a look at the situation first.
If Lu Yun really wants to attack Chen Mo, it won't be too late for her to come forward.
…
At the same time, Chen Mo had just walked out of the house. He had slept well last night and the real energy in his body was also very stable.
After a night of adjusting his breath, he felt that his condition was much better than yesterday, even though he was taken advantage of by that woman.
At this moment, he stood in the yard and stretched, and after standing for a while, he decided to go to the Sutra Pavilion to have a look.
Speaking of the Sutra Pavilion, it is not only the place where Qingyun Sect stores its exercises and spells, but also where both inner and outer sect disciples can go.
Outer disciples can only enter the first floor to view low-grade and mid-grade spells, but inner disciples can enter the second floor to view high-grade spells.
title_en: Chapter 9: Stop Chapter 10: Lu Yun was defeated
